title: Make background_social.py fear reactions (flee, hide, freeze) mutate real position, hidden, and pause state

sections.what: Execute real simulation state changes in engine/background_social.py when choose_fear_reaction selects 'flee', 'hide', or 'freeze' instead of recording text memories and affect spikes only.
sections.why: engine/background_social.py defines FEAR_REACTIONS = ('flee', 'hide', 'freeze', 'shout') and run_fear_pass (called from engine/background_simulation.py:339), yet _record_fear only appends log entries, memories, Social drain, and emotion spikes. A background NPC logged as having 'fled' stays standing in the exact same room with the threat, 'hide' leaves them unhidden, and 'freeze' does not pause their schedule.
sections.how:
1. Inspect _record_fear and run_fear_pass in engine/background_social.py (lines 1214-1415).
2. Implement actual state effects alongside memory/log recording:
   - 'flee': pick a safe open/passable adjacent exit away from the fear source and move the NPC there (updating area presence).
   - 'hide': find a hideable anchor in the area and mark hidden state / hidden edge (with fallbacks to flee/freeze if exposed).
   - 'freeze': record a brief freeze/hesitation cooldown/flag that skips normal wander/schedule travel during run_fear_pass.
   - 'shout': emit sound/turn notification consistent with engine/sound.py.
3. Add soak/pytest unit tests covering flee relocation, hide state activation, and freeze schedule pause.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering engine/background_social.py run_fear_pass for flee (verify current_area changes), hide (verify hidden state), and freeze (verify halted travel).\n2. Verify background soak smoke test passes with zero crashes when no exits or hideable items exist.

acceptance.text: In engine/background_social.py, choosing 'flee' moves the background NPC through an available open adjacent way out of the threat area when one exists.
Choosing 'hide' places the background NPC into hidden state (when cover/hideable anchor is present) rather than only logging prose.
Choosing 'freeze' pauses the character's movement/schedule advancement for the reaction duration while keeping vitals/cooldown accounting intact.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: World Graph / Event Stream during background simulation / soak advance.

Current availability: engine/background_social.py (FEAR_REACTIONS, _record_fear, run_fear_pass) selects 'flee', 'hide', 'freeze', or 'shout' and writes memories/logs/affect without mutating character position, hidden state, or movement execution.

Manual verification steps:
1. Run a background simulation pass with a fearful NPC co-located with a fear source.
2. Check the NPC's current_area, hidden state, and Event Stream logs afterward.
   - expected: 'flee' actually relocates the NPC to an adjacent area, 'hide' toggles hidden concealment if cover exists, and 'freeze' halts schedule movement briefly.
